740000101.text: Villains... You recalcitrant villains! That's right, run, run far, far away! To the other side of the mountain, to the city alleys — and make sure I don't see you!

740000103.text: Hmph. Nothing serious. Hero ran away again. It happens all the time — just say the word "inspection," and off Hero takes...

740000104.text: This time, Prince and Princess fled too... Had I not tripped when taking care of the flower field previously, leaving me with a yet-unhealed leg injury, dealing with those three rascals would've been easy.

740000105.text: Are you mountaineers? If you'd like a place to rest your feet, you can sit awhile in the house — I shall treat you in a bit once I have brought those three rapscallions back by their scruffs.

740000107.text: Wait, we vowed that? Paimon definitely wasn't consulted!

740000110.text: #Well, let's introduce ourselves all the same! Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he's}{F#she's} {NICKNAME}. We're adventurers — and if you're looking for people, there's no one more experienced than us!

740000111.text: If your legs aren't feeling too good, leave the searching to us!

740000112.text: Adventurers... Then why don't you wear those green uniforms?

740000113.text: Not everyone has to wear that outfit. Or rather, we're such experienced adventurers that we can just wear whatever we want.

740000114.text: Hmm. I see. I suppose that the services of seasoned adventurers should also come with the requisite payment.

740000115.text: Alright then, good children, call me Earnshaw. I would be most grateful for your help.

740000116.text: So you're looking for... Hero, Prince, and Princess? These don't sound like normal names... Are these nicknames for kids?

740000119.text: Really? Th—They, uh, sound like... rather kiddy names?

740000120.text: My daughter named them. If it was not for her raising hue and cry, I would not have raised such delicate creatures.

740000121.text: When they were still pups, they were quite silly and rather cute, but they quickly grew into disobedient little rascals. Try to control them a little, and ah, they resist and they flee.

740000122.text: They don't go very far, of course, but one does need to retrieve them all the same. Ah, for a "Hero" to fear something like a tooth inspection... What a joke.

740000109.text: Yup, and we definitely wouldn't sidetrack from our original goal because "the mountain was just there" or something like that!

740000202.text: Lanoire, Earnshaw! It's great to see you again!

740000203.text: How are you adjusting to life in your new home?

740000204.text: #Don't be silly, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}! This isn't my new home, it's my old home. Isn't that what Cater said?

740000205.text: Grandpa's Tasses Ragout is so tasty! He's teaching me how to make it, but it'll take awhile before I've got it down...

740000206.text: There's plenty of time, no need to rush it.

740000207.text: That reminds me, is this "Cater" not with you? I still haven't thanked him in person...

740000208.text: He had something else to take care of, so we've parted ways for now.

740000210.text: Do you think he's already forgotten about me, Ms. Paimon...?

740000211.text: Of course not! He's just tied up with something right now...

740000212.text: Besides... You two promised each other, right? The next time you meet, he'll finish telling that story from before, and you'll have lots of amazing stories to tell him, right?

740000214.text: Ahem! That reminds me, Hero has gone and wandered off and gone who-knows-where again. Lanoire, would you be a good girl and help Grandpa find him and bring him home?

740000215.text: I bet he's gotten himself all dirty playing outside. Bring him back and give him a bath.

740000216.text: Aww, just let him play outside. It's boring just staying inside all the time.

740000217.text: Well, if he runs off or gets snatched by a monster in the forest and can't come back, don't come crying to me.

740000218.text: Eek... I—I'll bring him back and give him a bath then!

740000219.text: Wonderful. Prince and Princess are playing in the garden right now, why don't you bring them back in, too? They're also probably covered head-to-toe in mud by now. I'll give them a good scrubbing later as well.

740000220.text: #Alrighty. {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, Ms. Paimon, you guys rest a while. I'll be right back!

740000221.text: Why don't we go with you? It'll be just like when we went on adventures in the Fortress.

740000222.text: You wanna come with me? That would be great!

740000223.text: Let me think... then let's call this adventure "Operation Rescue Hero"!

740000225.text: But he's just a doggy, and an old one at that! So, it's up to us brave young warriors to rescue him from the dust and mud!

740000228.text: You can go together, just remember not to let Hero eat anything too strange. He more than likely ran off to the north hut to play, if you head north you should run into him.

740000229.text: Okay! <color=#00E1FFFF>If he acts up and doesn't want to come home with us, I'll just take his food away</color>. Then he'll definitely be a good boy and come home!

740000230.text: Excellent. Also, <color=#00E1FFFF>don't trample the flowers behind the fence</color>!

740000231.text: #Well, you definitely don't have to worry about Ms. Paimon stepping on any! But don't worry, Grandpa. {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} and I will be careful.

740000227.text: Well... the name would be too long if we tried put them all in! Let's just say that rescuing Hero includes bringing Prince and Princess back inside too.

740000501.text: Great. You kids play with Lanoire for a little while.

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring Hero, Prince, and Princess home
Bring Hero, Prince, and Princess home
Bring Hero, Prince, and Princess home

740000401.text: Good children, I'm relying on you to bring those three rapscallions back.

740001201.text: So, this is the home I didn't know about that Cater talked about.

740001202.text: Welcome home, child. I'm just glad you're back...

740000601.text: Paimon thought that this would be easier... Who knew they'd be so capricious...

740000602.text: Well then, children, I hope you now understand that the more capricious they are, the more we need to teach them the rules.

740000604.text: If only you could also fly, eh? That would've made things way easier.

740000607.text: Well, if you're tired, rest here a while before going. Come, have some of this Tasses Ragout I just made while you're at it.

740000608.text: Ooh, goodies! But... Oh, we shouldn't. This doesn't seem right.

740000609.text: Come now, do you not trust my skills? I would not speak for other dishes, but I'm very confident in my Ragout, at least.

740000610.text: No, no, Paimon's wondering if this would count as not following the rules or something...

740000611.text: Labor deserves a reward, so this is what you are owed for your efforts. You need to eat to keep your strength up, after all. And you are adventurers... so you'll need that energy all the more.

740000612.text: As for your payment for the official commission, I will give it to you later — I believe the Guild's rules indicate as much.

740000613.text: Hehe! In that case, don't mind if we do!

740000614.text: At the old man's invitation, the two of you enjoy some Ragout. While it is not exactly a masterpiece, it warms the soul nonetheless, wiping your fatigue away...

740000615.text: A meal after some honest work always tastes especially great. And the Ragout was... Well, it had a real "homey" feel, eh?

740000616.text: Well, the ingredients and the method of cooking were nothing quite curious.

740000617.text: Yup. It was normal but tastes really good!

740000618.text: Of course. Even my silly daughter has naught but praises for this dish. Just a whiff of it would send her running to the table, putting all her complaints aside.

740000619.text: But she's very far away now, and I fear she can't smell my Ragout any longer — I'd wager that she's even forgotten the way home, in fact.

740000620.text: Hmm... Y'know, Earnshaw, if you don't mind telling us what she looks like, we could find her for you. We're good at that, remember?

740000621.text: If we meet her in our travels, that is.

740000622.text: Ah, you truly are good-hearted children. Thank you. In truth, it would not be hard for me to find her — she did get someone to send me some letters previously.

740000623.text: But I reckon she doesn't think she's at fault... Why else would she only send letters but not return home?

740000624.text: As such, I haven't read a single one of her letters. In fact, I haven't opened a single one. We can overlook the folly of animals, but are we to accept that from a human — a grown woman, no less?

740000625.text: Speaking of which, she hasn't sent any letters recently... Perhaps she's finally grown tired of trying to get a rise out of me.

740000626.text: Regardless, I shall not hire people specifically to bring her back. She can either admit fault and return herself, or not at all.

740000628.text: All the same, thank you for helping to bring Hero and the others back. The payment isn't much, even with the Ragout added in... So take both, would you?

740000629.text: You adventurers often sleep out in the wild, don't you? Well, remember to eat well and dress warmly. Don't starve, or catch a chill.

740000630.text: Yup. You take care of your leg too, Earnshaw!

740000631.text: See you. Take good care of yourselves!

740000606.text: Eh? C'mon, Paimon's not like that... Nor is she some kinda disobedient pet!

740000701.text: This operation... is trickier than Paimon expected.

740000702.text: That's because the giant in the garden really loves those little purple flowers, and he has all kinds of rules.

740000703.text: Unruly children should learn to follow the rules while they're still young. It's even harder to teach an old dog new tricks.

740000705.text: Huh? What's that got to do with Paimon? She's not an unruly child. Hmph!

740000708.text: Have you all tired yourselves out? I just happened to make some Tasses Ragout today, please, sit down and have some.

740000709.text: #Yes, yes! {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, Ms. Paimon, let's eat together!

740000710.text: #Alright! We couldn't turn down an invitation like that from Lanoire, could we, {NICKNAME}? Hehe.

740000712.text: You're Lanoire's friends, no need to be so polite.

740000713.text: Having been invited inside, you enjoy a simple but delicious meal of Tasses Ragout.\nOver the meal, you share stories from your journey that astonish the old man and make the little girl burst out laughing.\nA joyful time passes amid conversation and laughter...

740000714.text: What do you think? Isn't Grandpa's cooking even better than Wolsey's?

740000707.text: Hehe, but Paimon's definitely not gonna step on any flowers! Besides, she could fly over a high wall without a witch's help!
